hypothesis: Candidate V2's one-epoch relational objective may lack sufficient adaptable representation capacity in encoder layers 10-11. Unfreezing encoder layers 8-9 in addition to 10-11 should allow the same objective to reshape SELECTED-over-PLAUSIBLE features without changing optimization time, loss balance, threshold, or data.
finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run

expectedMeasurableEffect.primary: P0 raw-ranking Macro and selected-above-plausible rate exceed V2
expectedMeasurableEffect.secondary: P0 directional Macro exceeds V2 without increasing FP above V2 or the unchanged incumbent allowance
expectedMeasurableEffect.failureCondition: absolute logits rise broadly while relational margins remain flat or regress
